questions.question: What did the basket of summer fruit signify in Amos 8?
options: That the exile would soon be over
That a great harvest was at hand
That a king would restore the land
That the end had come upon Israel
questions.answer: That the end had come upon Israel

questions.question: What unusual famine does Amos 8 foretell?
options: A plague that swept through the cities
A famine of bread spread across the whole land
A famine of hearing the words of the LORD
A drought that dried up every stream
questions.answer: A famine of hearing the words of the LORD

questions.question: Amos 8 condemns merchants who cheat with false balances and trample the needy.
Behold, the days are coming when I will send a famine of hearing the words of the _____.
The basket of summer fruit meant 'the _____ has come upon my people Israel.'
